positions.name: KestrelwoodCalibrationEstablishment
positions.frame: how is the Kestrelwood spectrograph calibration established as a settled fact?
positions.why: Both expressions perform the establishment of the same calibration state — src-1 through expert verification against June reference plates (a claim grounded in demonstrated competence), src-2 through a decision-of-record ratification of the same fact. The conviction gradient (claim vs. decision) and relational difference (evidence-to-conclusion vs. authority-ranking) are internal tension the frame holds: one expression verifies, the other ratifies, but both answer the same question of how the 88.4 MHz calibration becomes settled.
